letters.subject: Invoice BIT-2026-1043: change of bank details
letters.body:
Hello Dan,

We have received invoice BIT-2026-1043, dated 1 October 2026, for £540.00, together with an email saying your bank details have changed. The new details on the invoice (sort code 00-99-01) are different from the ones we hold for you.

Before any payment is made, we will phone you on the number we already have on file to confirm the change. We never change bank details because of an email, so please don't send bank details by reply.

Kind regards,
Accounts Assistant
Demo Company Ltd

letters.subject: Invoice CWS-40218: total doesn't add up
letters.body:
Hello Steve,

Thank you for invoice CWS-40218, dated 14 October 2026. The net amount is £210.00 and the VAT is £42.00, which comes to £252.00, but the total due is shown as £262.00, a difference of £10.00.

Could you send a corrected invoice, please? We will hold this one until it arrives, so a reply by Friday 13 November would be appreciated.

Kind regards,
Accounts Assistant
Demo Company Ltd

letters.subject: Invoice 118: VAT registration number
letters.body:
Hello Jo,

Thank you for invoice 118, dated 31 October 2026, for £384.00. It includes £64.00 VAT, but no VAT registration number is shown and we don't have one on our records for you.

Could you send a VAT invoice showing your VAT registration number? If you are not VAT registered, please send a corrected invoice without VAT instead. A reply by Friday 13 November would help us pay you on time.

Kind regards,
Accounts Assistant
Demo Company Ltd
